description: Fix a PA derivation of \(\forall\vec x\,(A(\vec x)\to B(\vec x))\). In a PA model in the fixed ambient universe, the specified program combines its actual numeral specialization with an accepted certificate for \(A(\overline{\vec x})\) and returns an accepted certificate for the original code of \(B(\overline{\vec x})\), using the native implication-elimination constructor.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticProofPredicates.certified_mapFixedProof {r : ℕ}
  (A B : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin r))
  (h :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA
      (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.close (A.imp B)))
  (p : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.Program r) {M : Type}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  (x : Fin r → M)
  (hp :
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.Certified
      Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.axiomVerifier (p.value x)
      ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.FixedSyntaxPrograms.substitution A).value x)) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.Certified
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.axiomVerifier
    ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticProofPredicates.mapFixedProof A B h p).value x)
    ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.FixedSyntaxPrograms.substitution B).value x)
